chars.AHMED: AHMED: a young Moroccan man (28) wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a black stripe across the chest, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.HACKER: HACKER: a sinister man wearing a black hoodie with the hood pulled up so his face is in shadow, a black face mask, black gloves over the hands.
chars.CLIENT: CLIENT: a middle-aged Moroccan man wearing a brown leather jacket, beige shirt and grey trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small cluttered computer repair room in Azrou, Morocco. AHMED sits at a desk in front of a glowing laptop, turning his head in alarm, while HACKER looms right behind his chair in the shadows, leaning over his shoulder with a menacing posture. Tense, cold blue light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Daytime, the same small computer repair shop in Azrou with old PCs on shelves. AHMED leans close to his laptop, biting his nails nervously, sweating, worried something will break.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: AHMED at his desk at night, a mug of tea beside him, checking a laptop and a phone at the same time, focused and tired, a wall calendar behind him.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside the small repair shop in Azrou, CLIENT happily hands AHMED a stack of Moroccan dirham banknotes over the counter; AHMED smiles proudly, a laptop on the counter between them.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Close view of AHMED at his desk installing a program on his laptop; the laptop screen glows an ominous red; a dark creeping shadow comes out of the laptop screen toward him without him noticing; he looks relaxed and unaware.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A dark room full of many glowing monitors; HACKER sits in a chair watching the screens, which show blurry webcam views of a small room; he rubs his gloved hands together with evil satisfaction.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: HACKER typing fast on a keyboard in a dark room, green and blue light on him, a folder icon shape floating in the air made only of light, menacing atmosphere.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Late at night in his small bedroom in Azrou, AHMED sits on the edge of his bed holding his phone, a notification glow on his face, frowning with suspicion, laptop open on the desk behind him.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: AHMED stands frozen in total shock in his dark bedroom, both hands on his head, eyes wide, staring at the laptop; the laptop is seen from behind so its screen is not visible, cold light on his face. Dramatic.
